hero.title: Home of Luxury Timepieces
hero.description: Providing a curated selection of luxury timepieces

white_space.description: The Watch Collections is an independent watch dealer established in 2014 and headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia. A deep appreciation for the art and craftsmanship of mechanical timepieces drives us to connect every customer with a watch that truly reflects them.

journey.title: Behind The Journey
journey.description: Since the beginning, The Watch Collections has curated luxurious timepieces from the world’s top brands, including Audemars Piguet, Richard Mille, Rolex, Patek Philippe, Hublot, and more.
journey.description_2: We are dedicated to providing an exceptional in-store experience, ensuring that every timepiece is authentic, safe, and trustworthy. With honesty, expertise, and ethical service, we are here to help you find the perfect watch.

service.title: Giving The Best Services
service.description: Our mission is to build long-term relationships with our customers by delivering expert service, support, and guidance in making a smart investment
service.quote: “Nothing is more important than earning our customers’ trust. We ensure every customer is treated with proper ethics, respect, and honesty in every aspect of our business.”
